Write a paragraph of about 120 words explaining what version control is for.

reply.text: Version control is a system used to track changes made to code, documents, or other digital content over time. Its primary purpose is to manage different versions of a file or project, allowing users to collaborate and revert to previous versions if needed. Version control systems, such as Git, enable multiple users to work on the same project simultaneously without conflicts, by keeping a record of all changes made. This record, known as a commit history, allows users to easily revert to a previous version of the file or project, ensuring that changes are reversible and minimizing the risk of data loss or corruption.
